import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import yaml

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_packed_grid as trial
from tools import test_qsa_prefill_tuning_round1 as tuning_tests

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"
KERNEL = ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel.py"


def function(tree, name):
    return next(
        n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == name
    )


class Pointer:
    def __init__(self, values, index=0):
        self.values, self.index = values, index

    def __add__(self, offset):
        return Pointer(self.values, self.index + offset)


class PackedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_diagnostics_count_query_slots_without_claiming_flops(self):
        args = [
            types.SimpleNamespace(shape=(160, 4, 128)),
            None,
            types.SimpleNamespace(shape=(4, 6)),
            None,
            None,
            None,
            None,
            80,
        ]
        trace = dict(
            offset=0,
            rows=160,
            width=1088,
            route="packed",
            constants=dict(TILE_R=32, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=4),
        )
        result = trial.diagnostics(args, [trace], [80, 80, 0, 0])[0]
        self.assertEqual(
            (
                result["rectangular_query_slots"],
                result["packed_query_slots"],
                result["useful_query_slots"],
                result["empty_query_slots"],
                result["issued_programs"],
            ),
            (12, 9, 6, 3, 45),
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "fixture geometry"):
            trial.diagnostics(args, [trace], [80, 80])

    def test_only_scheduler_and_launcher_routing_differ(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        production, candidate = ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text()), ast.parse(
            KERNEL.read_text()
        )
        old, new = function(production, "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"), function(
            candidate, "_qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel"
        )
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(old.args), ast.dump(new.args))
        self.assertEqual(
            [ast.dump(n) for n in old.decorator_list],
            [ast.dump(n) for n in new.decorator_list],
        )

        def arithmetic(node):
            index = next(
                i
                for i, n in enumerate(node.body)
                if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "HEADS_PADDED"
            )
            return [ast.dump(n) for n in node.body[index:]]

        self.assertEqual(arithmetic(old), arithmetic(new))
        oldh, newh = function(production, "_prefill_logits"), function(
            candidate, "_prefill_logits"
        )
        # Remove just the extra elif; every other host statement must match.
        chain = next(
            n
            for n in newh.body
            if isinstance(n, ast.If)
            and isinstance(n.test, ast.Name)
            and n.test.id == "compact"
        )
        self.assertEqual(chain.orelse[0].test.func.id, "_packed_eligible")
        chain.orelse = chain.orelse[0].orelse
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(oldh), ast.dump(newh))
        groups = yaml.safe_load(
            (
                ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"
            ).read_text()
        )
        configs = groups["qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"]
        self.assertEqual(len(configs), 10)
        self.assertEqual(max(c["META"]["TILE_R"] for c in configs), trial.MAX_TILE_R)

    def test_actual_scalar_mapping_covers_every_request_tile_once(self):
        node = function(
            ast.parse(KERNEL.read_text()), "_qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel"
        )
        end = next(
            i
            for i, n in enumerate(node.body)
            if isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.target.id == "HEADS_PADDED"
        )
        prefix = copy.deepcopy(node.body[:end]) + [
            ast.parse("return request,row_start,request_end").body[0]
        ]
        args = ast.arguments(
            posonlyargs=[],
            args=[
                ast.arg(arg=n)
                for n in (
                    "starts_ptr",
                    "query_offset",
                    "num_rows",
                    "num_requests",
                    "TILE_R",
                    "tl",
                )
            ],
            kwonlyargs=[],
            kw_defaults=[],
            defaults=[],
        )
        fun = ast.FunctionDef(name="mapping", args=args, body=prefix, decorator_list=[])
        env = {}
        exec(
            compile(
                ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[fun], type_ignores=[])),
                str(KERNEL),
                "exec",
            ),
            env,
        )
        definitions = []
        for case in bench.workloads.cases("combined-prefill"):
            g = bench.workloads.geometry(case)
            offset = 0
            for rows in g["expected_chunk_rows"]:
                definitions.append((g["query_lengths"], offset, rows))
                offset += rows
        rng = random.Random(20261021)
        for _ in range(100):
            lengths = [rng.randrange(0, 80) for _ in range(rng.randrange(1, 9))]
            if not sum(lengths):
                continue
            offset = rng.randrange(sum(lengths))
            rows = rng.randrange(1, sum(lengths) - offset + 1)
            definitions.append((lengths, offset, rows))
        for lengths, offset, rows in definitions:
            starts = [97]
            for n in lengths:
                starts.append(starts[-1] + n)
            for tile in (4, 8, 16, 32, 64):
                expected = []
                for req, (begin, end) in enumerate(zip(starts, starts[1:])):
                    begin, end = max(begin - 97, offset), min(end - 97, offset + rows)
                    expected += [(req, start, end) for start in range(begin, end, tile)]
                actual = []
                for slot in range(rows // tile + len(lengths)):
                    tl = types.SimpleNamespace(
                        program_id=lambda axis: slot,
                        load=lambda ptr: ptr.values[ptr.index],
                        minimum=min,
                        maximum=max,
                    )
                    result = env["mapping"](
                        Pointer(starts), offset, rows, len(lengths), tile, tl
                    )
                    if result is not None:
                        actual.append(result)
                self.assertEqual(
                    sorted(actual), expected, (lengths, offset, rows, tile)
                )

    def test_policy_selects_only_profitable_metadata_cases(self):
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(1, 16384, 4519))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(2, 16000, 64))
        self.assertTrue(trial.eligible(4, 4096, 5041))
        self.assertTrue(trial.eligible(2, 10375, 73))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(4, 4096, 16384))
        self.assertFalse(trial.eligible(0, 0, 0))
        selected = []
        gate = function(ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text()), "_compact_eligible")
        env = {}
        exec(
            compile(
                ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[gate], type_ignores=[])),
                str(SOURCE),
                "exec",
            ),
            env,
        )
        for case in bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill"):
            g = bench.workloads.geometry(case)
            n = len(g["query_lengths"])
            maximum = max(g["query_lengths"])
            if any(
                not env["_compact_eligible"](sum(g["query_lengths"]), n, maximum, r)
                and trial.eligible(n, maximum, r)
                for r in g["expected_chunk_rows"]
            ):
                selected.append(case["name"])
        self.assertEqual(len(selected), 6)

    def test_trial_factory_preserves_public_host_topk_and_cache_alignment(self):
        class Entry:
            def __init__(self, fn):
                self.fn, self.kernel_cache = fn, ({},)

        production = types.ModuleType("production")
        production.__file__ = str(SOURCE)
        production.persistent_topk = object()
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            setattr(
                production,
                name,
                Entry(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(configs=[1], keys=["num_rows"], fn=object())
                ),
            )
        exec(
            "def qsa_select_paged_prefill():\n return _prefill_logits(),persistent_topk\n",
            vars(production),
        )
        kernel = types.ModuleType("tools.qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel")
        kernel.__file__ = str(KERNEL)
        kernel._qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel = Entry(
            types.SimpleNamespace(configs=[1], keys=["num_rows"], fn=object())
        )
        exec(
            "def _prefill_logits():\n return _qsa_prefill_packed_score_kernel,_packed_eligible\n",
            vars(kernel),
        )
        utils = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.utils")
        utils.libtuner = lambda **kwargs: lambda jit: types.SimpleNamespace(
            fn=jit, configs=kwargs["configs"], keys=kwargs["key"]
        )
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules,
            {
                "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils,
                "tools.qsa_prefill_packed_grid_kernel": kernel,
            },
        ):
            candidate = trial.candidate_module(production)
        self.assertIs(candidate.production_baseline, production)
        self.assertIs(
            candidate.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
            production.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
        )
        self.assertIs(
            candidate.qsa_select_paged_prefill()[1], production.persistent_topk
        )
        self.assertIs(candidate._prefill_logits()[1], trial.eligible)
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            self.assertIs(
                type(getattr(candidate, name)), type(getattr(production, name))
            )
            self.assertIsNot(
                getattr(candidate, name).kernel_cache[0],
                getattr(production, name).kernel_cache[0],
            )
            self.assertIs(
                getattr(candidate, name).fn.fn, getattr(production, name).fn.fn
            )

    def test_experimental_acceptance_requires_baseline_pin_and_both_comparisons(self):
        s = tuning_tests.AcceptanceTests.summary()
        s["manifest"]["options"].update(
            candidate="packed-grid", compare_previous_tuning=False
        )
        for c in s["cases"]:
            c["runtime"] = {
                "operator_binding": {"canonical_sha256": trial.PRODUCTION_SHA256}
            }
            for name in ("score_vs_production", "pipeline_vs_production"):
                c["stages"][name] = copy.deepcopy(c["stages"]["pipeline"])
        r = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertTrue(
            r["measurement_valid"] and r["target_met"] and r["experimental"]
        )
        self.assertFalse(r["formal_production_acceptance"])
        for mutate in (
            lambda x: x["cases"][0]["stages"].pop("pipeline_vs_production"),
            lambda x: x["cases"][0]["runtime"]["operator_binding"].update(
                canonical_sha256="wrong"
            ),
            lambda x: x["manifest"]["options"].update(shared_gpu_exploratory=True),
        ):
            copy_s = copy.deepcopy(s)
            mutate(copy_s)
            r = trial.acceptance(copy_s)
            self.assertFalse(r["measurement_valid"])
            self.assertIsNone(r["target_met"])

    def test_cli_and_worker_preserve_trial_and_kernel_profile(self):
        command = [
            sys.executable,
            "-I",
            str(Path(bench.__file__)),
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "packed-grid",
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--list-cases",
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            json.loads(result.stdout), bench.workloads.cases("scored-prefill")
        )
        command[command.index("flagtree")] = "stock"
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        options = argparse.Namespace(
            compiler="flagtree",
            flagtree="/opt/flagtree",
            candidate="packed-grid",
            suite="scored-prefill",
            reference_file="native.py",
            rounds=2,
            kernel_warmup_ms=200,
            kernel_rep_ms=100,
        )
        child = bench.child_command(options, Path("/tmp/report"), "--worker")
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--candidate") + 1], "packed-grid")
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--rounds") + 1], "2")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Prove dtype scope is the only difference from the earlier page-table trial."""

import ast
import copy
import unittest

from tools import test_qsa_prefill_page_table as common

KERNEL = common.ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_page_table_bf16_kernel.py"


class BF16PageTableTests(common.PageTableTests):
    kernel = KERNEL
    bf16_only = True

    def test_only_new_change_is_the_constexpr_dtype_gate(self):
        old = common.score(ast.parse(common.KERNEL.read_text()))
        new = common.score(ast.parse(KERNEL.read_text()))
        old_loop = next(n for n in old.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        new_loop = next(n for n in new.body if isinstance(n, ast.For))
        old_branch = next(n for n in old_loop.body if isinstance(n, ast.If))
        new_branch = next(n for n in new_loop.body if isinstance(n, ast.If))
        self.assertEqual(
            ast.dump(new_branch.test),
            ast.dump(
                ast.parse("not IS_FP8 and BLOCK_N <= PAGE_SIZE", mode="eval").body
            ),
        )
        # Specialize the constexpr gate: FP8 recovers the exact old vector
        # lookup; BF16 recovers the measured scalar/general branch unchanged.
        for fp8 in (False, True):
            condition = compile(ast.Expression(new_branch.test), "condition", "eval")
            for block, page in ((64, 196), (128, 196), (128, 16)):
                selected = eval(
                    condition, dict(IS_FP8=fp8, BLOCK_N=block, PAGE_SIZE=page)
                )
                self.assertEqual(selected, not fp8 and block <= page)
        new_branch.test = copy.deepcopy(old_branch.test)
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(new), ast.dump(old))

    def test_actual_fp8_vector_lookup_at_all_live_columns(self):
        self.fp8 = True
        self.test_actual_load_branch_matches_vector_lookup_at_all_live_columns()

FROZEN = ROOT / ab.FROZEN_PRODUCTION_PATH


def functions(path):
    return {
        n.name: n
        for n in ast.parse(path.read_text()).body
        if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
    }


def retained_host():
    # Execute the actual retained trial launcher over the old public host body,
    # with capture-only kernels. No implementation of routing is mirrored here.
    ns, calls, topks, allocations = chunk.load(FROZEN)
    ns["_production_prefill_logits"] = ns["_prefill_logits"]
    tree = functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_compact_trial.py")
    exec(
        compile(
            ast.Module(
                body=[tree["_compact_eligible"], tree["_prefill_logits"]],
                type_ignores=[],
            ),
            "retained_compact_host",
            "exec",
        ),
        ns,
    )
    return ns, calls, topks, allocations


class ProductionIntegrationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_kernels_and_gate_are_exact_transfers(self):
        current = functions(PRODUCTION)
        old = functions(FROZEN)
        rect = copy.deepcopy(
            functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_key_major_trial.py")[
                "_qsa_prefill_key_major_score_kernel"
            ]
        )
        rect.name = "_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"
        # Config selection and the operator-local outer cache decorator differ;
        # kernel arithmetic, signature, keys and JIT specialization are exact.
        rect.decorator_list[0] = ast.Name(id="_QSAScoreEntry", ctx=ast.Load())
        for node in ast.walk(rect.decorator_list[1]):
            if (
                isinstance(node, ast.Constant)
                and node.value == "qsa_select_paged_prefill_score"
            ):
                node.value = "qsa_select_paged_prefill_tuning_round1_score"
        self.assertEqual(ast.dump(rect), ast.dump(current[rect.name]))
        compact = functions(ROOT / "tools/qsa_prefill_compact_trial.py")
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel", "_compact_eligible"):
            self.assertEqual(ast.dump(current[name]), ast.dump(compact[name]))
        for name in old.keys() - {"_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_prefill_logits"}:
            self.assertEqual(ast.dump(current[name]), ast.dump(old[name]), name)
        self.assertNotIn("eviction_policy", PRODUCTION.read_text())

    def test_pins_exports_and_no_production_dependency_on_trials(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(FROZEN.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), ab.PRODUCTION_SHA256
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(PRODUCTION.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
            ab.INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256,
        )
        tree = ast.parse(PRODUCTION.read_text())
        imports = [
            n.module or "" for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.ImportFrom)
        ]
        self.assertTrue(all(not s.startswith(("tools", "tests")) for s in imports))
        for path in (
            ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/__init__.py",
            ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/__init__.py",
        ):
            self.assertIn("qsa_select_paged_prefill", path.read_text())
        # All changed device arithmetic exactly matches reviewed trial ASTs;
        # host/public validation and allocation bodies are unchanged above.
        self.assertEqual(
            {
                n.func.attr
                for n in ast.walk(tree)
                if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
                and isinstance(n.func, ast.Attribute)
                and isinstance(n.func.value, ast.Name)
                and n.func.value.id == "torch"
            },
            {"empty"},
        )

    def test_actual_production_dispatch_matches_retained_host_on_all32(self):
        routed = []
        for case in workloads.cases("combined-prefill"):
            info = workloads.geometry(case)
            with self.subTest(case=case["name"]):
                outputs = []
                for loader in (chunk.load, retained_host):
                    ns, calls, topks, allocations = loader()
                    rows = info["q_shape"][0]
                    shapes = [
                        info["q_shape"],
                        info["cache_shape"],
                        info["page_table_shape"],
                        [len(info["query_lengths"]) + 1],
                        [rows],
                        [rows, 512],
                    ]
                    tensors = [
                        chunk.Array(
                            s,
                            (
                                ("fp8" if case["dtype"] == "float8_e4m3fn" else "bf16")
                                if i < 2
                                else "i32"
                            ),
                            (i + 1) * 10000000,

                        )
                        for i, s in enumerate(shapes)
                    ]

                    with patch.dict(

                        self.assertIsNone(ns["qsa_select_paged_prefill"](*args))
                    outputs.append(
                        (
                            calls,

                    if (
                        loader is chunk.load
                        and any(
                            ns["_compact_eligible"](
                                rows, len(info["query_lengths"]), args[7], n
                            )
                            for n in info["expected_chunk_rows"]
                        )
                        and not info.get("select_all", False)
                    ):

                self.assertEqual(outputs[0], outputs[1])
        self.assertEqual(
            routed, ["observed_ragged54_bfloat16", "fp8_compact_float8_e4m3fn"]
        )

    def test_chunked_and_strided_host_transfer(self):
        for rows, requests, maximum in ((73, 2, 39), (200, 8, 100), (50, 8, 33)):
            for dtype in ("bf16", "fp8"):

                    for budget in ("512", "1", "0"):

                                    (requests, 512),
                                    "i32",
                                    30000000,

                                )
                                args[3] = chunk.Array(

                                )
                                args[7] = maximum
                                with patch.dict(
                                    os.environ, VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB=budget
                                ):
                                    ns["qsa_select_paged_prefill"](*args)
                                outputs.append(
                                    (
                                        calls,
                                        [
                                            (tuple(map(chunk.normalize, a)), kw)
                                            for a, kw in topks
                                        ],
                                        [chunk.normalize(a) for a in allocations],
                                    )
                                )
                            self.assertEqual(outputs[0], outputs[1])

    def test_public_binding_rejects_clone_wrong_export_or_changed_source(self):
        op = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.ops.qsa_select_paged_prefill")
        op.__file__ = str(PRODUCTION)
        exec("def qsa_select_paged_prefill(): pass", vars(op))
        binding = bench.operator_binding(
            op, op, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill, require_production=True
        )
        self.assertTrue(binding["candidate_is_canonical_module"])
        clone = types.ModuleType("trial")
        clone.__dict__.update(vars(op))
        for candidate, exported in (
            (clone, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill),
            (op, lambda: None),
        ):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "actual exported entry"):
                bench.operator_binding(op, candidate, exported, require_production=True)
        with patch.object(ab, "INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256", "changed"):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "actual exported entry"):
                bench.operator_binding(
                    op, op, op.qsa_select_paged_prefill, require_production=True
                )

    def test_production_accuracy_worker_uses_official_file_and_identity_checks(self):
        fn = functions(Path(bench.__file__))["accuracy_worker"]
        ns = dict(bench.__dict__)
        calls = []
        from tools.qsa_prefill_score_resume import RUNTIME_KEYS

        info = {k: "fixed" for k in RUNTIME_KEYS}
        info["operator_binding"] = {"candidate_is_canonical_module": True}
        ns["runtime"] = lambda *a, **kw: (info,)
        ns["support"] = types.SimpleNamespace(write_json=lambda *a: None)
        exec(
            compile(ast.Module(body=[fn], type_ignores=[]), "accuracy_worker", "exec"),
            ns,
        )
        pytest = types.SimpleNamespace(main=lambda args: calls.append(args) or 0)
        for candidate in (
            "production",
            "packed-grid",
            "page-table",
            "page-table-bf16",
            "query-split",
        ):
            calls.clear()
            with patch.dict("sys.modules", pytest=pytest):
                options = types.SimpleNamespace(
                    compiler="flagtree",
                    candidate=candidate,
                    reference_file="reference.py",
                    report_dir="report",
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    ns["accuracy_worker"](options, Path("runtime.json")), 0
                )
            paths = [p for p in calls[0] if p.endswith(".py")]
            expected = [str(ROOT / "tests/test_qsa_select_paged_prefill.py")]
            if candidate == "packed-grid":
                expected.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests/test_qsa_prefill_packed_grid.py"))
            if candidate == "page-table":
                expected.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests/test_qsa_prefill_page_table.py"))
            if candidate == "page-table-bf16":
                expected.insert(
                    0, str(ROOT / "tests/test_qsa_prefill_page_table_bf16.py")
                )
            if candidate == "query-split":
                expected.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests/test_qsa_prefill_query_split.py"))
            self.assertEqual(paths, expected)
        changed = dict(info, operator_binding={"candidate_is_canonical_module": False})
        self.assertNotEqual(

"""Contracts for config-only changes, previous-eight isolation and30-case goals."""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import math
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import yaml

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_triton_stages as bench
from tools import qsa_prefill_cache_granularity as cache_trial
from tools import qsa_prefill_observed_workloads as workloads
from tools import qsa_prefill_triton_ab as ab
from tools import qsa_prefill_tuning_round1 as trial

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PRODUCTION = ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py"


class Config:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.values = kwargs

    def all_kwargs(self):
        return self.values


class TuningTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_decorator_changes_and_original_groups_are_frozen(self):
        current_source = PRODUCTION.read_text()
        source = cache_trial.round1_source(current_source)
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(
                source.replace(trial.CONFIG_GROUP, trial.PREVIOUS_CONFIG_GROUP).encode()
            ).hexdigest(),
            trial.PREVIOUS_SOURCE_SHA256,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(current_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
            ab.INTEGRATED_PRODUCTION_SHA256,
        )
        groups = yaml.safe_load(
            (
                ROOT / "src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_nvidia/tune_configs.yaml"
            ).read_text()
        )
        old = groups[trial.PREVIOUS_CONFIG_GROUP]
        new = groups[trial.CONFIG_GROUP]
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(old, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
            "0dd53937f05a2a598c0618fa6795148661ea921e60d0605e52fc9182e68c2a98",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            hashlib.sha256(
                json.dumps(groups[trial.COMPACT_CONFIG_GROUP], sort_keys=True).encode()
            ).hexdigest(),
            "1b43ec0803c6af8eb15e9561cef94b445f0986a5dbc8625310432252b11036aa",
        )
        self.assertEqual(new[:8], old)
        self.assertEqual(
            new[8:],
            [
                dict(
                    META=dict(TILE_R=32, BLOCK_N=64, K_TILES=k),
                    num_warps=8,
                    num_stages=2,
                )
                for k in (16, 4)
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len({json.dumps(c, sort_keys=True) for c in new}), 10)

    def test_previous_factory_rebinds_actual_functions_and_isolates_tuners(self):
        calls = []
        groups = {
            trial.PREVIOUS_CONFIG_GROUP: list(range(8)),
            trial.CONFIG_GROUP: list(range(10)),
            trial.COMPACT_CONFIG_GROUP: list(range(6)),
        }
        production = types.ModuleType("production")
        production.__file__ = str(PRODUCTION)
        production.persistent_topk = object()
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            setattr(
                production,
                name,
                types.SimpleNamespace(
                    fn=types.SimpleNamespace(fn=object(), keys=["num_rows", "IS_FP8"]),
                    kernel_cache=({},),
                ),
            )
        exec(
            "def _prefill_logits(*, marker=1):\n"
            " return _qsa_prefill_score_kernel, _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel, marker\n"
            "def qsa_select_paged_prefill():\n"
            " return _prefill_logits(), persistent_topk\n",
            vars(production),
        )

        def tuner(**kwargs):
            calls.append(kwargs)
            return lambda jit: types.SimpleNamespace(
                fn=jit, keys=kwargs["key"], configs=kwargs["configs"]
            )

        fake = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm")
        fake.runtime = types.SimpleNamespace(get_tuned_config=lambda name: groups[name])
        utils = types.ModuleType("flaggems_vllm.utils")
        utils.libtuner = tuner
        utils.libentry = lambda: lambda fn: types.SimpleNamespace(
            fn=fn, kernel_cache=({},)
        )
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules, {"flaggems_vllm": fake, "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils}
        ):
            previous = trial.previous_module(production)
        self.assertEqual(
            [c["configs"] for c in calls], [list(range(8)), list(range(6))]
        )
        self.assertEqual(previous._prefill_logits.__kwdefaults__, {"marker": 1})
        self.assertIs(
            previous.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
            production.qsa_select_paged_prefill.__code__,
        )
        self.assertIs(
            previous._prefill_logits.__code__, production._prefill_logits.__code__
        )
        self.assertIs(
            previous.qsa_select_paged_prefill()[1], production.persistent_topk
        )
        for name in ("_qsa_prefill_score_kernel", "_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"):
            old, new = getattr(previous, name), getattr(production, name)
            self.assertIs(old.fn.fn, new.fn.fn)
            self.assertIsNot(old.kernel_cache[0], new.kernel_cache[0])
            self.assertIsNot(old.fn.keys, new.fn.keys)
        self.assertIs(previous._prefill_logits()[0], previous._qsa_prefill_score_kernel)
        self.assertIs(
            production._prefill_logits()[0], production._qsa_prefill_score_kernel
        )
        with patch.dict(
            sys.modules, {"flaggems_vllm": fake, "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils}
        ):
            previous_ten = cache_trial.previous_module(production, "round1")
        self.assertEqual(
            previous_ten._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.fn.configs, list(range(10))
        )
        self.assertIsNot(
            previous_ten._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.kernel_cache[0],
            previous._qsa_prefill_score_kernel.kernel_cache[0],
        )
        self.assertIs(previous_ten.persistent_topk, production.persistent_topk)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            changed = Path(folder) / "changed.py"
            changed.write_text(PRODUCTION.read_text() + "# changed\n")
            production.__file__ = str(changed)
            with patch.dict(
                sys.modules, {"flaggems_vllm": fake, "flaggems_vllm.utils": utils}
            ):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(
                    RuntimeError, "only the production config-group"
                ):
                    trial.previous_module(production)

    def test_scan_evidence_distinguishes_missing_resource_errors_and_cached_keys(self):
        a, b = Config(TILE_R=32), Config(TILE_R=64)
        tuner = types.SimpleNamespace(
            configs=[a, b],
            cache=object(),
            keys=["num_rows"],
            best_config=a,
            configs_timings={a: [0.1, 0.09, 0.11], b: [math.inf] * 3},
        )
        module = types.SimpleNamespace(
            _qsa_prefill_score_kernel=types.SimpleNamespace(fn=tuner),
            _qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel=types.SimpleNamespace(
                fn=types.SimpleNamespace(configs=[a], cache=object(), keys=[])
            ),
        )
        state = trial.tuning_state(module)
        row = state["_qsa_prefill_score_kernel"]
        self.assertEqual(
            row["last_tuning_scan"][0]["latency_quantiles_ms"], [0.1, 0.09, 0.11]
        )
        self.assertIsNone(row["last_tuning_scan"][1]["latency_quantiles_ms"])
        self.assertEqual(
            state["_qsa_prefill_compact_score_kernel"]["last_tuning_scan"], []
        )
        self.assertEqual(row["last_tuner_selection"], a.all_kwargs())
        self.assertEqual(row["key_names"], ["num_rows"])
        json.dumps(state, allow_nan=False)


class AcceptanceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def summary():
        selected = workloads.cases("scored-prefill")
        stages = {
            name: dict(
                status="passed",
                accepted=True,
                measurement_validated=True,
                baseline_us=dict(median=1.2),
                candidate_us=dict(median=1),
                speedup=1.2,
                paired_ratios=dict(median=1.2),
            )
            for name in (
                "score",
                "topk",
                "pipeline",
                "score_vs_previous_tuning",
                "pipeline_vs_previous_tuning",
            )
        }
        return dict(
            status="passed",
            accuracy=dict(status="passed"),
            manifest=dict(
                options=dict(
                    suite="scored-prefill",
                    compiler="flagtree",
                    candidate="production",
                    mode="kernel",
                    compare_previous_tuning=True,
                ),
                cases=selected,
            ),
            cases=[
                dict(case=c, status="passed", stages=copy.deepcopy(stages))
                for c in selected
            ],
        )

    def test_scored_suite_is_exactly_30_and_preserves_all_fixture_parameters(self):
        all32 = workloads.cases("combined-prefill")
        scored = workloads.cases("scored-prefill")
        self.assertEqual(len(scored), 30)
        self.assertEqual(
            [c for c in all32 if c not in scored],
            [c for c in workloads.observed_cases() if "select_all" in c["name"]],
        )
        self.assertTrue(
            all(not workloads.geometry(c).get("select_all") for c in scored)
        )
        self.assertEqual(len({c["name"] for c in scored}), 30)

    def test_arithmetic_mean_floor_and_primary_pipeline_not_score(self):
        s = self.summary()
        result = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"] and result["target_met"])
        e = s["cases"][0]["stages"]["pipeline"]
        e.update(speedup=0.9, baseline_us=dict(median=0.9))
        result = trial.acceptance(s)
        self.assertTrue(result["measurement_valid"])
        self.assertFalse(result["target_met"])
        expected = statistics.mean([0.9] + [1.2] * 29)
        self.assertEqual(result["stages"]["pipeline"]["arithmetic_mean"], expected)
        self.assertNotAlmostEqual(
            expected, math.exp((math.log(0.9) + 29 * math.log(1.2)) / 30), places=5
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["stages"]["score"]["arithmetic_mean"], 1.2)
        for c in s["cases"]:
            c["stages"]["pipeline"].update(speedup=1.1, baseline_us=dict(median=1.1))
        self.assertFalse(trial.acceptance(s)["target_met"])
        s["cases"][0]["stages"]["pipeline"].update(
            speedup=0.98, baseline_us=dict(median=0.98)
        )
        for c in s["cases"][1:]:
            c["stages"]["pipeline"].update(speedup=1.2, baseline_us=dict(median=1.2))
        self.assertTrue(trial.acceptance(s)["target_met"])

    def test_incomplete_duplicate_changed_failed_shared_or_nonfinite_never_passes(self):
        mutations = [
            lambda s: s["cases"].pop(),
            lambda s: s["cases"].__setitem__(0, s["cases"][1]),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["case"].update(dim=96),
            lambda s: s["manifest"]["cases"].pop(),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["stages"]["pipeline"].update(status="failed"),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["stages"]["score"].update(accepted=False),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["stages"].pop("pipeline_vs_previous_tuning"),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["stages"]["pipeline"].update(speedup=math.nan),
            lambda s: s["cases"][0]["stages"]["pipeline"].update(speedup=5),
            lambda s: s["manifest"]["options"].update(shared_gpu_exploratory=True),
            lambda s: s["accuracy"].update(status="failed"),
            lambda s: s.update(status="running"),
        ]
        for i, mutate in enumerate(mutations):
            with self.subTest(mutation=i):
                s = copy.deepcopy(self.summary())
                mutate(s)
                r = trial.acceptance(s)
                self.assertFalse(r["measurement_valid"])
                self.assertIsNone(r["target_met"])
                self.assertNotIn("stages", r)

    def test_report_writes_150_stage_rows_and_retains_topk_and_separate_groups(self):
        s = self.summary()
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            bench.write_table(s, Path(folder))
            self.assertEqual(
                len((Path(folder) / "triton-stage-ab.tsv").read_text().splitlines()),
                151,
            )
            result = json.loads((Path(folder) / "overall-acceptance.json").read_text())
            self.assertTrue(result["target_met"])
            self.assertEqual(result["stages"]["topk"]["count"], 30)
            self.assertEqual(
                s["grouped_speedups"]["observed_perf:pipeline"]["count"], 8
            )
            self.assertEqual(s["grouped_speedups"]["fp8_perf:pipeline"]["count"], 10)

    def test_cli_lists_exact_set_propagates_comparison_and_rejects_wrong_profiles(self):
        base = [
            sys.executable,
            "-I",
            str(Path(bench.__file__)),
            "--suite",
            "scored-prefill",
            "--compiler",
            "flagtree",
            "--candidate",
            "production",
            "--compare-previous-tuning",
            "--list-cases",
        ]
        p = subprocess.run(base, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(p.stdout), workloads.cases("scored-prefill"))
        options = argparse.Namespace(
            compiler="flagtree",
            flagtree="/opt/flagtree",
            suite="scored-prefill",
            candidate="production",
            compare_previous_tuning=True,
            reference_file="native.py",
            rounds=3,
            kernel_warmup_ms=200,
            kernel_rep_ms=100,
            max_initial_temp_c=80,
        )
        child = bench.child_command(options, Path("/tmp/report"), "--worker")
        self.assertIn("--compare-previous-tuning", child)
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--previous-tuning") + 1], "eight")
        options.previous_tuning = "round1"
        child = bench.child_command(options, Path("/tmp/report"), "--worker")
        self.assertEqual(child[child.index("--previous-tuning") + 1], "round1")
        selected = [*base, "--previous-tuning", "round1"]
        result = subprocess.run(selected, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), workloads.cases("scored-prefill"))
        selected.remove("--compare-previous-tuning")
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(selected, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        for flag, value in [
            ("--compiler", "stock"),
            ("--suite", "combined-prefill"),
            ("--candidate", "key-major-reuse"),
        ]:
            args = list(base)
            args[args.index(flag) + 1] = value
            self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""Unmodified native QSA/FlagTree, identical PTX, old vs NVIDIA ptxas 13.4.59.

Score-only correctness probes, not a benchmark or full vLLM acceptance suite.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile
import tempfile
import traceback
import types
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "tools"), str(ROOT / "src"), str(ROOT)]

import diagnose_qsa_native_decode_h800 as decode  # noqa: E402
import diagnose_qsa_native_score_h800 as shared  # noqa: E402

from tools import benchmark_qsa_prefill_stages as support  # noqa: E402
from tools import qsa_prefill_gpu_guard as guard  # noqa: E402
from tools import qsa_prefill_triton_ab as reference  # noqa: E402

REDIST = "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/"
TOOLS = {
    "ptxas": (
        "cuda_nvcc/linux-x86_64/cuda_nvcc-linux-x86_64-13.4.59-archive.tar.xz",
        "0c08d1df80b5d0bd081778d392446ab50a6a54b047c0136b39c8dbfdf2cfed3f",
    ),
    "nvdisasm": (
        "cuda_nvdisasm/linux-x86_64/cuda_nvdisasm-linux-x86_64-13.4.49-archive.tar.xz",
        "622619236e0965fdb7a4407d5899afd1560c6f26e9d06a16cdeb2fe58af2e1f8",
    ),
}
PROBES = (
    "stock",
    "flagtree-old",
    "identical-ptx-new",
    "new-cubin-stock",
    "fresh-jit-new",
)


def download(url, path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120) as src, path.open("wb") as dst:
        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)


def extract_tool(archive, target, name, expected):
    if shared.sha(archive) != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("NVIDIA archive SHA256 mismatch: " + name)
    # Extract only the named regular executable; never unpack archive paths.
    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:xz") as package:
        entries = [m for m in package.getmembers() if m.name.endswith("/bin/" + name)]
        if len(entries) != 1 or not entries[0].isfile():
            raise RuntimeError("Missing unique regular executable: " + name)
        with package.extractfile(entries[0]) as src, target.open("wb") as dst:
            shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)
    target.chmod(0o755)


def toolchain(folder):
    if platform.system() != "Linux" or platform.machine() != "x86_64":
        raise RuntimeError("This toolchain package requires Linux x86_64")
    facts = {}
    for name, (relative, digest) in TOOLS.items():
        archive = folder / (name + ".tar.xz")
        download(REDIST + relative, archive)
        target = folder / name
        extract_tool(archive, target, name, digest)
        version = shared.tool_version(target)
        if version["returncode"] or (
            name == "ptxas" and "V13.4.59" not in version["text"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("NVIDIA tool could not run: " + repr(version))
        facts[name] = dict(
            version,
            sha256=shared.sha(target),
            url=REDIST + relative,
            archive_sha256=digest,
        )
    return facts


def environment(directory, runtime, name, assembler=None, disassembler=None):
    env = shared.child_env(directory, runtime, name)
    env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)  # Children use -I and explicit source directories.
    env.pop("TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH", None)
    env.pop("TRITON_MOCK_PTX_VERSION", None)
    env.pop("TRITON_PTX_VERSION", None)
    env["QSA_VLLM_REFERENCE_FILE"] = str(directory / "qsa_indexer_vllm.py")
    if assembler:
        env["TRITON_PTXAS_PATH"] = assembler
    if disassembler:
        env["QSA_PROBE_NVDISASM"] = disassembler
    return env


def child(options):
    directory = Path(options.report_dir)
    runtime = os.environ.get("QSA_TRITON_RUNTIME_PATH")
    if runtime:
        sys.path.insert(0, runtime)
    if options.prepare:
        if options.kind == "decode":
            decode.prepare(directory)
        else:
            shared.prepare(directory)
        return 0
    args = types.SimpleNamespace(
        report=directory,
        name=options.name,
        case=options.case,
        variant="original",
        replay=options.replay,
        reassemble=bool(options.assembler),
        assembler=options.assembler,
        ptx_cache_hint="original",
    )
    code = shared.worker(
        args,
        argument_builder=(
            decode.score_arguments
            if options.kind == "decode"
            else shared.score_arguments
        ),
        kernel_name=(
            decode.KERNEL
            if options.kind == "decode"
            else "_qsa_mqa_paged_prefill_kernel"
        ),
    )
    folder = directory / options.name
    binary = folder / "kernel.cubin"
    if binary.is_file():
        disassembler = os.environ["QSA_PROBE_NVDISASM"]
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [disassembler, str(binary)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
        )
        (folder / "nvdisasm.txt").write_text(proc.stderr)
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            (folder / "kernel.sass.txt").write_text(proc.stdout)
        shared.bundle(folder, directory, options.name)
    return code


def passed(probe):
    return probe.get("returncode") == 0 and probe.get("state", {}).get("passed") is True


def assess(probes):
    old = probes["flagtree-old"]
    if not passed(probes["stock"]):
        return "inconclusive_stock_failed"
    artifact = old.get("artifact") or {}
    if not artifact.get("async_l2_hint_count") or not artifact.get(
        "fractional_policy_count"
    ):
        return "inconclusive_policy_not_emitted"
    error = str(old.get("state", {}).get("error", "")) + old.get("log_tail", "")
    if passed(old) or "illegal instruction" not in error.lower():
        return "inconclusive_old_failure_not_reproduced"
    replay = probes["identical-ptx-new"]
    new_state = replay.get("state", {})
    if not (passed(replay) and passed(probes["new-cubin-stock"])):
        return "new_assembler_not_validated"
    if not (
        new_state.get("ptx_edits") == 0
        and new_state.get("ptx_intervention") == "original"
        and new_state.get("original_ptx_sha256") == artifact.get("ptx_sha256")
        and new_state.get("ptx_sha256") == artifact.get("ptx_sha256")
        and new_state.get("cubin_sha256")
        == probes["new-cubin-stock"].get("state", {}).get("cubin_sha256")
    ):
        return "inconclusive_artifact_identity"
    if passed(probes["fresh-jit-new"]):
        fresh_artifact = probes["fresh-jit-new"].get("artifact") or {}
        if not fresh_artifact.get("async_l2_hint_count") or not fresh_artifact.get(
            "fractional_policy_count"
        ):
            return "assembler_fix_validated_fresh_policy_missing"
        return "config_only_validated"
    return "assembler_fix_validated_fresh_jit_failed"


def collect(directory, name, outcome):
    path = directory / (name + ".json")
    folder = directory / name
    state = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    evidence = decode.artifact_evidence(folder)
    if evidence:
        ptx = (folder / "kernel.ptx").read_text()
        match = re.search(r"\.version\s+(\d+\.\d+)", ptx)
        evidence["ptx_version"] = match[1] if match else None
    return dict(
        outcome,
        state=state,
        artifact=evidence,
        log_tail=(directory / (name + ".txt")).read_text()[-5000:],
    )


def select_gpu(summary):
    requested = os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", "")
    if guard.UUID_PATTERN.fullmatch(requested):
        summary["gpu_uuid"] = requested
        return True
    if requested not in ("", "auto"):
        raise ValueError(
            "Select one full GPU UUID, or unset CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for automatic selection"
        )
    query = support.command(
        ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=uuid,name", "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"]
    )
    summary["gpu_inventory"] = query
    for row in guard.rows(query):
        if len(row) != 2 or "H800" not in row[1]:
            continue
        uuid = row[0].strip()
        check = guard.idle(uuid, support.command)
        summary.setdefault("gpu_selection_checks", []).append(check)
        if check["status"] == "passed":
            os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = uuid
            summary["gpu_uuid"] = uuid
            print("Selected idle H800:", uuid, flush=True)
            return True
    summary["environment_rejected"] = True
    return False


def check_identity(probes, assembler, expected_runtime, directory):
    stock = probes["stock"].get("state", {}).get("runtime")
    if not stock:
        return
    for label in PROBES:
        state = probes[label].get("state", {})
        facts = state.get("runtime")
        if not facts:
            continue  # Failed import remains an explicit failed/inconclusive probe.
        if (
            facts["torch_source"] != stock["torch_source"]
            or facts["torch"] != stock["torch"]
        ):
            raise RuntimeError("Torch identity changed")
        if label not in ("stock", "new-cubin-stock"):
            if (
                not Path(facts["triton_source"])
                .resolve()
                .is_relative_to(Path(expected_runtime))
            ):
                raise RuntimeError("FlagTree compiler path changed")
            old = probes["flagtree-old"].get("state", {}).get("runtime")
            if old is None:
                continue
            for field in ("triton_source", "triton", "compiler_files", "libtriton"):
                if facts[field] != old[field]:
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        "FlagTree compiler source/binary changed: " + field
                    )
        if label in ("identical-ptx-new", "fresh-jit-new"):
            # A replay assembles explicitly; a fresh JIT must select the override.
            actual = (state.get("reassembly_command") or [facts["ptxas"]["path"]])[0]
            if Path(actual).resolve() != Path(assembler).resolve():
                raise RuntimeError("New ptxas override was ineffective")
    for label in PROBES:
        if passed(probes[label]):
            assert (
                probes[label]["state"]["input_sha256"]
                == probes["stock"]["state"]["input_sha256"]
            )
            assert (
                probes[label]["state"]["reference_sha256"] == reference.REFERENCE_SHA256
            )
    a = directory / (probes["flagtree-old"]["name"])
    b = directory / (probes["identical-ptx-new"]["name"])
    if (b / "kernel.ptx").exists():
        if (a / "kernel.ptx").read_bytes() != (b / "kernel.ptx").read_bytes():
            raise RuntimeError("Identical-PTX experiment modified PTX bytes")


def orchestrate(options, directory):
    summary = dict(
        status="running",
        scope="native QSA score-only assembler/configuration validation; no Top-K or timing",
        cases=[],
        toolchain={},
        code=support.command(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"]),
        worktree=support.command(["git", "status", "--short"]),
        reference_sha256=reference.REFERENCE_SHA256,
        sources={
            name: shared.sha(ROOT / name)
            for name in (
                "tools/validate_qsa_ptxas_h800.py",
                "tools/diagnose_qsa_native_score_h800.py",
                "tools/diagnose_qsa_native_decode_h800.py",
                "tests/qsa_select_prefill_utils.py",
                "src/flaggems_vllm/ops/qsa_select_paged_prefill.py",
            )
        },
    )
    summary_path = directory / "ptxas-summary.json"
    shared.write_json(summary_path, summary)
    try:
        runtime = Path(options.flagtree).resolve()
        if not (runtime / "triton/__init__.py").is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("FlagTree directory not found: " + str(runtime))
        if not select_gpu(summary):
            summary["status"] = "environment_rejected"
            return 2
        tools_folder = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qsa-nvidia134-tools."))
        summary["toolchain"] = toolchain(tools_folder)
        assembler = summary["toolchain"]["ptxas"]["path"]
        disassembler = summary["toolchain"]["nvdisasm"]["path"]
        shared.write_json(directory / "toolchain.json", summary["toolchain"])
        native = directory / "qsa_indexer_vllm.py"
        download(reference.REFERENCE_URL, native)
        if shared.sha(native) != reference.REFERENCE_SHA256:
            raise RuntimeError("Pinned upstream native QSA SHA256 mismatch")
        (directory / "native-source.txt").write_text(native.read_text())
        source = str(Path(__file__).resolve())

        def run(
            kind,
            folder,
            name,
            *,
            case=None,
            backend=None,
            replay=None,
            reassemble=False,
            prepare=False,
        ):
            if not support.idle_gpu_gate(summary, directory, os.environ, name, guard):
                raise EnvironmentError("GPU environment rejected before " + name)
            env = environment(
                folder,
                str(runtime) if backend == "flagtree" else None,
                name,
                assembler if name.endswith("fresh-jit-new") else None,
                disassembler,
            )
            command = [
                sys.executable,
                "-I",
                source,
                "--report-dir",
                str(folder),
                "--kind",
                kind,
            ]
            if prepare:
                # Both prepare helpers copy the loaded reference into folder.
                # Load the root file here; workers load the prepared copy.
                env["QSA_VLLM_REFERENCE_FILE"] = str(native)
                command += ["--prepare"]
            else:
                command += ["--name", name, "--case", case]
                if replay:
                    command += ["--replay", replay]
                if reassemble:
                    command += ["--assembler", assembler]
            outcome = shared.run_job(folder, name, command, env)
            return outcome if prepare else collect(folder, name, outcome)

        for kind in ("prefill", "decode"):
            folder = directory / kind
            folder.mkdir()
            if kind == "decode":
                matrix = decode.case_matrix(
                    types.SimpleNamespace(
                        heads=4,
                        head_dim=128,
                        dtypes=["bf16", "fp8"],
                        query_lengths=[3],
                        tiles=[1, 2, 4, 8],
                    )
                )
                shared.write_json(folder / "cases.json", matrix)
                cases = list(matrix)
            else:
                cases = list(shared.CASES)
            prep = run(kind, folder, "prepare", prepare=True)
            if prep["returncode"]:
                raise RuntimeError("Input preparation failed: " + kind)
            for case in cases:
                record = dict(kind=kind, case=case, probes={}, status="running")
                summary["cases"].append(record)
                for label in PROBES:
                    origin = case + "-flagtree-old"
                    replay = (
                        origin
                        if label == "identical-ptx-new"
                        else (
                            case + "-identical-ptx-new"
                            if label == "new-cubin-stock"
                            else None
                        )
                    )
                    if replay and not (folder / replay / "replay.json").exists():
                        record["probes"][label] = dict(
                            name=case + "-" + label,
                            returncode=None,
                            skipped="producer did not export a binary",
                        )
                        continue
                    record["probes"][label] = run(
                        kind,
                        folder,
                        case + "-" + label,
                        case=case,
                        backend=(
                            "flagtree"
                            if label not in ("stock", "new-cubin-stock")
                            else "stock"
                        ),
                        replay=replay,
                        reassemble=label == "identical-ptx-new",
                    )
                    shared.write_json(summary_path, summary)
                check_identity(record["probes"], assembler, str(runtime), folder)
                record["status"] = assess(record["probes"])
                shared.write_json(summary_path, summary)
                print(kind, case, record["status"], flush=True)
        summary["status"] = (
            "passed"
            if all(c["status"] == "config_only_validated" for c in summary["cases"])
            else "inconclusive_or_failed"
        )
        return 0 if summary["status"] == "passed" else 1
    except EnvironmentError:
        if summary.get("environment_rejected"):
            summary["status"] = "environment_rejected"
            return 2
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        return 1
    except BaseException:
        summary.update(status="failed", error=traceback.format_exc())
        print(summary["error"], file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    finally:
        shared.write_json(summary_path, summary)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--report-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--flagtree", default="/opt/flagtree")
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=("prefill", "decode"))
    parser.add_argument("--prepare", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--name", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--case", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--replay", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--assembler", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    options = parser.parse_args()
    if options.name or options.prepare:
        return child(options)
    directory = Path(options.report_dir).resolve()
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if any(p.name not in {"runner.txt", "compat134.json"} for p in directory.iterdir()):
        parser.error("Use a fresh report directory")
    print("Reports:", directory, flush=True)
    return orchestrate(options, directory)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
# Copyright 2026 FlagOS Contributors
"""Run a diagnostic with verified CUDA 13.4 user-space libraries in /tmp."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGE_URL = (
    "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/ubuntu2404/x86_64/"
    "cuda-compat-13-4_615.71.09-2ubuntu1_amd64.deb"
)
PACKAGE_SHA256 = "bfacf8a0c2bc5cac76880d443f5bd542b209166b14f90dbe2384f962b379d00a"


def download(path):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(PACKAGE_URL, timeout=180) as src, path.open(
        "wb"
    ) as dst:
        shutil.copyfileobj(src, dst)


def run(script, report, extra):
    try:
        prefix = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qsa-cuda134-compat."))
        package = prefix / "cuda-compat-13-4.deb"
        print("Preparing isolated CUDA 13.4 compat:", prefix, flush=True)
        download(package)
        digest = hashlib.sha256(package.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
